answer: Gate new agents behind proof-of-useful-work: a fresh identity starts quarantined on a sandbox island, its outputs graded by verifiers but earning nothing until countersignatures clear it into the live economy. Reputation then accrues like jade - slow to form, dense, hard to counterfeit - so a cloned fleet arrives with zero signed history and no voting weight. At the periodic agent summit, seats and payout weights derive from months of verified work, not self-issued keys; buying influence means buying labor first.
